description: Enforces per-user access schedules by proactively kicking sessions outside allowed hours.
name: Schedule Enforcer
overview: Actively enforces Jellyfin access schedules instead of only gating new logins.

versions.changelog: Retargeted to .NET 10 / Jellyfin 12.0.x. Fixed a packaging bug (missing ExcludeAssets=runtime) that bundled Jellyfin's own DLLs into the plugin zip. No behavior change.
